evals.expected_output: Skill verifies <docs-dir>/AGENTS_CONTEXT.md exists, locates the recruitment subdomain's CONTEXT.md (via CONTEXT-MAP.md if multi-context), reads the existing Vocabulary table, then interviews the user one question at a time via AskUserQuestion — leading with a Recommended canonical for Candidate vs. Applicant and asking the user to split 'account' into two distinct terms. evals.prompt: fill in the CONTEXT.md vocabulary for this repo
evals.expected_output: Skill verifies prerequisites, picks the target CONTEXT.md (single-context: the only one; multi-context: asks the user which subdomain), reads the existing file plus any unresolved entries in Flagged ambiguities, then drives an interview prioritizing existing flagged ambiguities first, then synonyms observed in the conversation, then new concepts. Appends results following the append-only rule from <docs-dir>/AGENTS_CONTEXT.md.

If 'job' was previously in the Vocabulary table or Flagged ambiguities, the skill handles it via supersession (new entry referencing the old) rather than rewriting history.
